paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Marta, [Pesachim 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.33b.8). Shmuel bar Marta, or R' Shmuel, [Berakhot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25b.24), [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.15).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The colon markers, sometimes followed by periods, give 121b/33b/25b/113b conventionally; none is newly verified. Earlier יצתק and omitted 25b are machine differences, not adopted source forms.

Berakhot and 25b join across the line break. This is a collection of patronymic attestations; catalog all-sages scope does not prove exhaustive coverage or one father. The explicit or between untitled Shmuel bar Marta and R' Shmuel remains; both abbreviated personal titles stay R'. Abba is explicit.

In Shabbat, Abba bar Marta is also called Abba bar Minyomi. Berakhot names the household of “Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta.” In Pesachim 113b Rabbah bar bar Chana reports Rabbi Shmuel bar Marta, who transmits Rav’s teaching in Rabbi Yose of Hutzal’s name. [Heilprin’s Yitzchak notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2159&lang=en) uses the longer patronymic.
